claim_boundary: Canonical fixture anchor fidelity only; this is not a with_skill/without_skill capability uplift measurement.

anchors.evidence: test_analysis.risk_model and test_flow carry source refs; review_conclusion closes before tech-lead handoff.
test_cases[] include product_refs, design_refs, assertion_target, steps, expected_result, and evidence_expectation.
design_gap_report.status is NO_GAPS; completion gate would block if any typed gap had blocking=true.
qa_handoff_contract[] includes obligation_id, obligation_type, trigger_refs, qa_stage, requiredness, execution_mode, skip_policy, evidence_contract_ref, and design_source_refs.
review_conclusion has R1 CONFIRMATION, R2 COMPLETE, three reviewer perspectives, zero FAIL verdicts, and convergence_evidence.
special_test_triggers map specialty risks to TEST_CASE or QA_HANDOFF refs instead of expanding every risk into E2E.
